title: Home Purchase Financing Contract Clauses — Funding, Final Note Rate, Installment and First Due Date
content:
**Retail installment contract — funding and repayment clauses (Home Purchase Financing)**

**Clause 1 — Signature and funding.** Signing the retail installment contract is the borrower's own act; funding follows the signature. The amount financed is advanced to the seller on the funding date and becomes the opening unpaid principal.

**Clause 2 — Final note rate.** The final note rate is the locked rate less the program's autopay rate reduction when autopay is elected at closing.

**Clause 3 — Installment.** The level monthly principal-and-interest installment amortizes the amount financed over the program's term in months at the final note rate. The monthly rate is the note rate divided by 12 (as a percentage, the note rate divided by 1200). The installment is the amount financed times the monthly rate, divided by one less the reciprocal of one plus the monthly rate raised to the power of the number of installments in the term, rounded half up to the cent. The last installment absorbs any rounding difference.

**Clause 4 — First installment and maturity.** The first installment falls on the borrower's chosen due day in the first month in which that day is at least the program's first-payment minimum of calendar days after the funding date. Maturity is the due date of the last installment.

**Clause 5 — Escrow at closing.** Where escrow is required, or elected on a program that does not require it, the monthly escrow deposit at closing is the first-year premium divided by 12, and the first-year premium is paid from closing funds.

### Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

*Installment.* An amount financed of 45925.00 over 240 installments at a final note rate of 9.24 percent has a monthly rate of 0.0077; the level installment comes to 420.31 after rounding half up.

*First due date.* With a first-payment minimum taken as 30 days and funding on 2026-03-20: on a chosen due day of the 15th, 2026-04-15 is 26 days after funding and too soon, so the first installment falls on 2026-05-15; on a chosen due day of the 1st, 2026-04-01 is too soon and the first installment falls on 2026-05-01.

*Escrow deposit.* A first-year premium of 1140.00 gives a monthly escrow deposit of 95.00 at closing.
